_about: Public-domain Charles Le Roy Goodell (1854-1937), Methodist pastor in New York and secretary of evangelism of the Federal Council of Churches, for the Word Hoard: The Pastor's Vade Mecum, My Mother's Bible, The Drillmaster of Methodism, The Price of Winning Souls, Pathways to the Best, Pastoral and Personal Evangelism, Followers of the Gleam, Heralds of a Passion, Cyclopedia of Evangelism, Pastor and Evangelist, What are You Worth?, Motives and Methods in Modern Evangelism, and Twilight Reveries. He lived past 1930, so only books printed before 1930 are taken. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 115 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

goodell-vade-mecum: The Pastor's vade mecum : containing the ritual for baptism, reception of members, the Lord's supper, matrimony, and burial of the dead : also hymns and scripture lessons for various occasions (New York : Eaton & Mains, 1886)
